touchpoints.screen: Payment Activity statuses; Beneficiary Notification email

moments.frontstage: Typical wire status flow: Entered → Approved → Released (extracted to back office; cannot be modified/unapproved) → Bank Received → Bank Confirmed (final). Failure states: Approval Window Passed, Rejected, Balance Check Failure (retries until cutoff). Beneficiary Notification email sent 'when the payment has been confirmed by the bank'; wire advice by email/fax/phone/mail (legacy); 6 pm ET cutoff; ISO 20022 for Fedwire since July 2025.
